text: nice. so will paint also be able to procederally generate ? [Image #8] like the strokes
resolution: Design answer on procedural paint generation: today's Save Painting stores the baked atlas, which already works as a pick-one axis (shared UVs mean any painting fits any family head — paint variant × mesh mix is multiplicative for free). The generative step (recolor, jitter, region mixing, mirror-replay) needs paintings kept as stroke PROGRAMS — the direction the repo already ruled for map paint and roads. Recommended palette-slot colors (skin/lip/iris named slots) as the highest-yield knob, ~3-4 authored face programs, and persisting the stroke list into paints/ alongside the baked variant as the concrete next feature (sibling of the pose-variant save specced for mouth visemes).
